Press information

This page is for journalists, event organisers and partners writing about Qilich: the company in one sentence, a short boilerplate, the key facts and the logo files. You can use them as they are.

In one sentence

Qilich is a Japanese IT agency in Tashkent that builds mobile apps, websites, Telegram bots, backend systems and AI integrations to Japanese standards.

Boilerplate

Qilich is a Japanese IT agency in Tashkent. It builds iOS and Android apps, websites and web platforms, Telegram bots, backend systems and integrations, desktop apps, IoT and AI integrations for businesses in Uzbekistan and for companies in Japan.

Qilich works the Japanese way: a written plan before work starts, a report every day (hōrensō), nothing released untested, and steady improvement after launch (kaizen). The team works in Tashkent, four hours behind Tokyo.
